caption: Lighthouse, Westkapelle
composition: Square Gothic tower with an iron lantern, seen from the sea dike · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the sea dike at Westkapelle the square brick tower of the former Sint-Willibrorduskerk rises in the village. Heavy buttresses and stone corner blocks mark the Gothic stages. An iron lantern sits on the top instead of a church spire, and the nave is gone. The North Sea lies beside the grass dike. The sky is partly cloudy, about 17.6°C, with wind near 11.5 km/h.
